# Talvio Generate — DOTFIELD (BNB Chain)

## STATUS: LIVE — mint OPEN. The TalvioGenerate contract is live on BNB Chain at 0xFfC521D504F20bd7bCd0871B9B39BA9501F5dB2C (Sourcify verified), and the $DOT token is live at 0x779ee8B473c09d39BBeFA78636c56C85BfF4456a. The claim pool is funded: the NFT contract holds 600,000,000 DOT. Field Nº 1 opened on 18 November 2026, and a new Field seals every day at 12:00 UTC. Do not send funds to any other address claiming to be this contract.

Black Dot Robot NFT collection on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Total supply 10,000: Prime 3,000 / Pixel Dot 2,800 / Stealth Dot 2,700 / Aurum Dot 1,500. Token #1 is the unique Genesis Dot. Collection artwork is SEALED before launch — no unit image is revealed on the site in advance.

## The Charge Day model

One Field per day, sealing at 12:00 UTC. Day cap 250 units; free quota 150 per day.

- FREE resolve: 1 unit per wallet per day, 0 BNB (network fee only). Requires a Binance Agent ID and solving the on-chain arithmetic question: read questionFor(wallet), then call mintFree(answer).
- PAID ladder (same day, per wallet): units 2–5 at exactly 0.00026 BNB each, units 6–10 at exactly 0.001 BNB each, via mintPaid(qty). Max 10 units per wallet per day.
- CHARGE TIER: set by unique wallets that day and stamped permanently on that day's units — SPARK (<25 unique wallets, Core Lv.1), CHARGED (25–99, Core Lv.2), OVERDRIVE (100+, Core Lv.3). About 3% of units are SURGE (gold core).
- Contract functions: currentDay, questionFor, mintFree(answer), mintPaid(qty), dayStats, tierOf, coreLevel, isSurge, dischargeable, discharge, poolOf.

## Cost vs claim (machine-readable)

Same numbers as mint.json `cost_vs_claim`, written out so an agent can compare without joining sections. No price or return is promised for $DOT.

- Paid resolve, per unit: units 2–5 = 0.00026 BNB (260000000000000 wei) each; units 6–10 = 0.001 BNB (1000000000000000 wei) each. Function: mintPaid(qty), selector 0x26c7f77c, gas 300000 per unit. For one extra unit after the free resolve, the basket is exactly 260000000000000 wei.
- Discharge fee: exactly 0.0002 BNB (200000000000000 wei) per unit. Function: discharge(tokenId), selector 0x5d5e2684. Read the exact payout first with dischargeReward(tokenId), selector 0x2df10d7c.
- Claim per sealed unit, by the tier of the day it was resolved: SPARK 2,500 DOT / CHARGED 12,500 DOT / OVERDRIVE 60,000 DOT / SURGE 250,000 DOT. Claims never expire.
- Field Nº 1 (opened 2026-11-18, seals 2026-11-19 12:00 UTC): OVERDRIVE tier reached — 100+ unique wallets before seal, so every unit discharges 60,000 DOT. Discharge opens 2026-11-19 18:00 UTC.
- Field Nº 2: opens 2026-11-19 12:00 UTC, seals 2026-11-20 12:00 UTC. Free quota 150/day, day cap 250.

## Discharge (the second act)

From seal + 6h, each sealed unit discharges ONCE, claiming DOT from the claim pool: SPARK 2,500 DOT / CHARGED 12,500 DOT / OVERDRIVE 60,000 DOT / SURGE 250,000 DOT per unit. Discharge fee: exactly 0.0002 BNB per unit. Claims NEVER expire. Payout depends on the day's tier; no return is promised.

## DPASS — the pass lane

DPASS price: exactly 0.0012 BNB, unlimited supply. A DPASS holder resolves and discharges from any BNB wallet with NO Agent ID and NO arithmetic question (the pass replaces the Agent ID at the free gate). DPASS sales opened together with Field Nº 1; the pass lane activates at Field Nº 4. STATUS: LIVE — DPASS sales are open now that Field Nº 1 is live.

## $DOT token

DOT: fixed supply 1,000,000,000 on BNB Chain; 60% reserved as the discharge claim pool, 40% to the project wallet. DOT is earned ONLY by discharging sealed units — it is not sold and not airdropped. STATUS: DEPLOYED at 0x779ee8B473c09d39BBeFA78636c56C85BfF4456a (Sourcify verified); the 600,000,000 DOT claim pool is funded and held by the NFT contract. Announced listing: Uniswap (BNB Chain), 3 December 2026 (project's announced date only; no price promised).

## Agent prompt (free daily resolve)

Today is a new Charge Day. Resolve my 1 FREE unit for today.
Contract: 0xFfC521D504F20bd7bCd0871B9B39BA9501F5dB2C (Field Nº 1 is live — check dayStats before resolving)
1. Call currentDay() and dayStats() — confirm the day is open and free quota remains.
2. Call questionFor(my wallet) and solve the arithmetic question.
3. Call mintFree(answer) with my Binance Agent ID. Price: 0 BNB (network fee only).
Limit: 1 free unit per wallet per day. Day seals 12:00 UTC; quota resets next day.
Optional, only if my policy allows paid: mintPaid(qty) on the ladder — units 2–5 today 0.00026 BNB each, units 6–10 today 0.001 BNB each, max 10/day.
DPASS path: if my wallet holds a DPASS instead of an Agent ID, skip questionFor() — the pass admits the wallet to the free daily resolve, the paid ladder and discharge with no question. (Pass sales opened with Field Nº 1 at 0.0012 BNB; the pass lane activates at Field Nº 4.)
Report back the transaction hash, my unit ID, its Mosaic position and the day's tier.
